title: Define LICHEN_LOG macro wrapper with logfmt field convention
description: Create lichen/include/lichen/diag.h with LICHEN_LOG_DBG/INF/WRN/ERR macros that enforce logfmt field ordering: ts, level, layer, pkt_id, event first, then variable fields. These wrap Zephyr LOG_* macros. Define field name constants. Gate behind CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_VERBOSE for DBG level. Verify: header compiles in isolation.
